scope.description: Coffee-export receipts attributed by the institutional historian to historical Colombia in 1880; product-specific foreign-trade flow, not GDP or modern-border total.

evidence.locator: Coffee chronology, paragraph beginning Aunque los ingresos en dólares; rendered lines 94–99, especially 98

qualifications: Annual historian-reported product receipts; original dollar unit and year retained. No inflation adjustment, interpolation or territorial aggregation.
Not GDP, government revenue, all exports, output tonnage or a claim that coffee dominated every regional economy.
